package courseclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func (c Client) ResolveLessonRevision(ctx context.Context, lessonID, revisionID string) (domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	method, path := http.MethodGet, "/internal/lesson-revisions/"+revisionID
	if revisionID == "" {
		method, path = http.MethodPost, "/internal/lessons/"+lessonID+"/revision"
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/")+path, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LessonRevision{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LessonRevision{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 && resp.StatusCode != 201 {
		return domain.LessonRevision{}, fmt.Errorf("lesson revision request failed: %s", resp.Status)
	}
	var r domain.LessonRevision
	if err = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&r); err != nil {
		return r, err
	}
	if r.Schema != "lesson-revision.v1" || r.LessonID != lessonID || (revisionID != "" && r.ID != revisionID) {
		return r, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return r, nil
}
